correctness.rationale: The explicitly provided 12-vertex, 24-edge triangle-free Chvátal graph yields matching complex f=(24,204,752,1175,628,52). Independently regenerated every face (2836 including empty), pivot Morse matching with 1399 nonempty face pairs and one critical 0-cell, 32 critical 3-cells, four critical 4-cells, and checked Hasse acyclicity. Computed exact signed gradient path boundary B (32x4) with Smith factors 1,1,1,3 and selected -3 determinant. Thus integral 3-homology Z^28 plus Z/3, and 3/4-dimensional CW attaching maps classify the claimed wedge^28 S3 plus Moore M(Z/3,3). Matching complex is flag; the standard flag support lower bound for H3 is 8, with equality the fourfold S0 join. Enumerated all 72 three-vertex paths and all 423 disjoint four-path covers -> precisely 423 induced octahedral 3-spheres. Independent signed projection verifies only index 262 is rational boundary (coefficients [-2/3,-2/3,1/3,-1/3], hence exact 3-torsion); 422 are rationally nontrivial and infinite. Augmented 32x427 matrix has all 32 unit Smith factors, proving integral generation, not only Q-span. This was a complete exact computation of the supplied finite complex, not extrapolation from a partial census or saved log.

evidence: Complete-graph and chessboard complexes differ from induced sparse Chvátal subgraph; homology does not descend as a consequence. Outerplanar theorem excludes Chvátal since 24>2*12-3=21 edges.
